fields: L6 Hong Kong / Mid-Autumn Festival (inline roller skates; Central → Victoria Harbour → The Peak). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4 / L5. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 月饼摊 Mooncake Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh must equal choices; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12 where CJK=1, ASCII=0.5), peak_final = The Peak / 太平山顶 final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational, no bare arithmetic). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Peak final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 中秋谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L5 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: 傍晚维港有 240 位游客，其中 20% 在看叮叮车，有多少人在看叮叮车？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Over four evenings, Flora counts 9, 15, 22 and 14 boats passing the harbour. What is the mean number per evening?
questions.q_zh: 连续四个晚上，Flora 在维港数到 9、15、22、14 条船，平均每晚几条？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A welcome mat at the Peak lookout is 16 m long and 5 m wide. What area does it cover in square metres?
questions.q_zh: 太平山观景台的迎宾地毯长 16 米、宽 5 米，面积是多少平方米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the harbour, 38 red lanterns and 8 gold lanterns hang for Mid-Autumn. How many more red lanterns than gold ones are there?
questions.q_zh: 维港为中秋挂了 38 盏红灯笼和 8 盏金灯笼，红灯笼比金灯笼多几盏？
questions.qtype_zh: 比较相差（多多少/高多少）
